Volunteer support

Contribute expertise without crossing the consumer firewall.

Volunteer participation is reviewed. Credentials, conflicts and role boundaries matter, and no volunteer receives private consumer material merely by signing up.

Application

Boundaries

Review before access

  • Credential and identity checks as appropriate.
  • Conflict review before case-specific involvement.
  • No promise of expert status or court qualification.
  • No private consumer access without consent and administrative authorization.
  • No guaranteed assignment, compensation or outcome.
